# Background music

“New Direction” — Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com).
Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Official track: https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/index.html?isrc=USUAN1100677
Original download: https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/mp3-royaltyfree/New%20Direction.mp3
Author's permission and attribution guidance: https://incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/faq.html

Changes: a 160-second segment starting at 40 seconds was edited into a 156-second
loop with a 4-second crossfade, then encoded as stereo AAC at 96 kbps. No new
musical material was added. `ambient.m4a` is played quietly at volume 0.14.
The visible bilingual footer gives the author, source, license and modification credit.

To replace the music, replace `ambient.m4a` with an AAC/M4A file and update
`musicCredit` in `dist/homepage-copy.js`, the initial footer in `dist/index.html`,
and this provenance record for the new recording. A different file type also
requires updating the audio source in `dist/index.html` and `dist/ambient-audio.js`.
